source: Oh, hey! Good morning, Yoshi!
translation: 哦，嘿！早上好，Yoshi！

source: Seems like you might’ve partied a bit too much last night...
translation: 看来你昨晚可能派对玩得有点过头了……

source: Y-Yeah, I’m a little groggy this morning… I’ve always been a lightweight when it comes to booze.
translation: 是、是啊，我今天早上有点昏沉……我喝酒一向很容易醉。

source: Good thing I don’t drink alcohol. Hangovers are the worst…
translation: 幸好我不喝酒。宿醉最难受了……

source: Wait, really?! What did I see you chugging last night then?!
translation: 等等，真的吗？！那我昨晚看见你猛灌的是什么？！

source: Th-That was iced-coffee… Yuri made it for me…
translation: 那、那是冰咖啡……Yuri给我做的……

source: So that’s why you’re not dying like the rest of us this morning! Hahaha!
translation: 原来这就是为什么你今天早上不像我们其他人一样快死了！哈哈哈！

source: Well… I had just as much fun with everyone… Watching you all slowly get drunk was rather… interesting.
translation: 嗯……我和大家一样玩得很开心……看着你们慢慢喝醉也相当……有趣。

source: Ahehe… It’s been a while since Yuri let us all drink at the camp.
translation: 啊哈哈……Yuri已经很久没有让我们在营地喝酒了。

source: I was hoping that’d happen… *cough* I-I don’t mean our project getting cancelled…!
translation: 我还希望那会发生……*咳嗽* 我、我不是说希望我们的项目被取消……！

source: Where is everybody though? Did I wake up late again…?
translation: 不过大家都去哪儿了？我又起晚了吗……？

source: No, you didn’t! I actually woke up just a bit before you.
translation: 没有，你没有！其实我只比你早醒了一点。

source: Jin here was just catching me up on what we missed!
translation: 这里的Jin刚刚在告诉我我们错过了什么！

source: W-Well… I’m just doing regular maintenance on our website.
translation: 嗯、嗯……我只是在对我们的网站做日常维护。

source: Lloyd and Darius are doing some minor repair work at the site before the workers arrive.
translation: 工人到之前，Lloyd和Darius正在现场做些小修缮。

source: Oh right, they should be showing up tomorrow.
translation: 哦，对，他们应该明天就会到。

source: Meanwhile, Yuri and Emilia left a while ago to take the scouts back home.
translation: 与此同时，Yuri和Emilia不久前出发，送童子军们回家了。

source: What about Goro though?
translation: 那Goro呢？

source: I think he’s in his office with Mr. Clermont.
translation: 我想他和Clermont先生在办公室里。

source: Same, actually. But I think he’s really enjoying his visit here.
translation: 我也这么想。不过我觉得他真的很享受这次来访。

source: It’s like a vacation for him!
translation: 这对他来说就像度假一样！

source: Anyway, I should probably get to work and prep brunch!
translation: 总之，我大概该去工作，准备早午餐了！

source: I guess I’ll get dressed too and see if there’s anything I can assist Goro with for Mr. Clermont.
translation: 我想我也该穿好衣服，看看有没有能帮Goro接待Clermont先生的地方。

source: What about you, Jin? Wanna come with me?
translation: 你呢，Jin？想和我一起去吗？

source: I-I’m fine staying here…
translation: 我、我待在这里就好……

source: I’ll wear just an apron and let you watch, if you join~
translation: 如果你加入，我就只穿围裙让你看哦～

source: Call me Sous-chef Hyunjin Choi, then.
translation: 那就叫我Hyunjin Choi副厨师吧。

source: Ahehe… just try not to faint, Jin.
translation: 啊哈哈……Jin，尽量别昏过去。

source: I’d really appreciate if you gave it more thought, Mr. Nomoru. I’d be thrilled to see Camp Buddy expand its horizons.
translation: Nomoru先生，如果您能再仔细考虑一下，我会非常感激。我会很高兴看到伙伴营地拓展它的版图。

source: There’s so much untapped potential here, and I would like to be a part of its future.
translation: 这里有太多尚未开发的潜力，我想成为它未来的一部分。

source: Thank you for the offer, Mr. Clermont. I will definitely consider it.
translation: 感谢您的提议，Clermont先生。我一定会认真考虑。

source: O-Oh, good morning, gentlemen! I hope I didn’t interrupt anything!
translation: 哦、哦，早上好，先生们！希望我没有打扰到什么！

source: Not at all! We just finished a little meeting and I’m about to take my leave.
translation: 完全没有！我们刚结束一个小会，我正要告辞。

source: Thanks again for staying with us, Mr. Clermont. We appreciate you taking the time out of your busy schedule to spend time with us yesterday.
translation: 再次感谢您和我们住在一起，Clermont先生。我们很感激您从繁忙的日程中抽出时间，昨天陪伴我们。

source: I’m the one who should be thanking you! You’ve all been so hospitable to me!
translation: 该道谢的是我！你们大家都对我如此好客！

source: And I must say, this is one of the best mini vacations I’ve taken in a long time!
translation: 而且我得说，这是我很久以来最棒的一次短途度假！

source: I was not aware of the severity of her well-being at the time…
translation: 当时我并不知道她的身体状况有多严重……

source: You can rest easy about her here.
translation: 你可以放心她在这里的情况。

source: Wonderful! Now, I believe it’s time for me to leave.
translation: 太好了！现在，我想是我该离开的时候了。

source: Lastly, Mr. Nomoru, please let me know when you’ve come to a decision regarding my offer!
translation: 最后，Nomoru先生，等您对我的提议作出决定后，请告诉我！

source: And feel free to consult with Mr. Nagira here as well!
translation: 也请随时向这里的Nagira先生征询意见！

source: I’ll keep that in mind, Mr. Clermont.
translation: 我会记在心里的，Clermont先生。

source: Anyway, you all need to start your day, so it’s best I be on my way.
translation: 总之，你们都需要开始新的一天了，我最好就此告辞。

source: Please let me escort you out at least.
translation: 至少请让我送您出去。

source: No need! I already know my way to the entrance and my driver should already be waiting.
translation: 不必！我已经知道去入口的路了，我的司机应该也已经在等着。

source: Thank you again, and I hope to see you all sometime soon!
translation: 再次感谢，也希望不久后能再见到大家！

source: Take care, Mr. Clermont!
translation: 请保重，Clermont先生！

source: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！

source: Wow, I didn’t expect you and Mr. Clermont to jump into work stuff right away this morning.
translation: 哇，我没想到你和Clermont先生一大早就开始谈工作。

source: Especially after how much we drank last night, hehe…
translation: 尤其是在我们昨晚喝了那么多之后，嘿嘿……

source: Ah, you mean the meeting? We were just having coffee and chatting, and the conversation moved in that direction.
translation: 啊，你是说会议？我们只是在喝咖啡聊天，话题就转到了那个方向。

source: It turns out another reason he wanted to visit was to discuss it.
translation: 原来他想来拜访的另一个原因就是讨论这件事。

source: Oh, I see! I’m sorry I missed it… I wish I’d gotten up earlier to join in!
translation: 哦，我明白了！很抱歉我错过了……真希望我能早点起来加入！

source: What was it about, if you don’t mind me asking?
translation: 如果你不介意我问的话，那是关于什么的？

source: To sum it up, he wants to expand Camp Buddy’s reach and asked if I was interested in reacquiring the previous branches that were shut down.
translation: 简而言之，他想扩大伙伴营地的影响力，并问我是否有兴趣重新收购此前关闭的分部。

source: He offered to provide all the funding needed to renovate them in exchange for becoming a full-fledged shareholder of the franchise.
translation: 他提出会提供翻新它们所需的全部资金，条件是成为这个品牌的正式股东。

source: What?! Really?! That’s amazing news!
translation: 什么？！真的吗？！这真是太棒的消息了！

source: I know, I couldn’t believe it either.
translation: 我知道，我也不敢相信。

source: Especially after getting a chance to talk to him about what happened back at the hotel.
translation: 尤其是在有机会和他谈过酒店发生的事之后。

source: I expected him to be disappointed, but he was very understanding. And then following it up with yet another business opportunity…
translation: 我原以为他会很失望，但他非常理解。之后又紧接着给出另一个商业机会……

source: Did he tell you why he wanted to do it?
translation: 他告诉你为什么想这么做了吗？

source: Well, Mr. Clermont is an entrepreneur. His business has plenty of investments that he’s funded and earns passively from, and Camp Buddy has caught his attention.
translation: 嗯，Clermont先生是一位企业家。他的企业有许多由他出资、可带来被动收益的投资，而伙伴营地吸引了他的注意。

source: From what I understood, he thinks our camp is worth expanding to make it reach its full potential, both financially and performance-wise.
translation: 据我理解，他认为我们的营地值得扩张，让它在财务和运营方面都发挥全部潜力。

source: He’s also a huge fan of the spirit of this place, and wants to allow more people to experience it.
translation: 他也是这里精神氛围的忠实喜爱者，想让更多人体验到它。

source: I see… Mr. Clermont always does talk about how happy he is Felix got to experience this place, so that makes a lot of sense!
translation: 我明白了……Clermont先生总会说他很高兴Felix体验过这里，所以这很合理！

source: Either way, this is exciting news!
translation: 不管怎样，这都是令人兴奋的消息！

source: Did you accept? It sounds like you didn’t give him an answer yet.
translation: 你接受了吗？听起来你还没有给他答复。

source: Yeah, I didn’t want to decide on the spot. Especially with something so important.
translation: 是啊，我不想当场决定。尤其是这么重要的事。

source: Yeah, I didn’t want to decide on the spot. Especially with something so important.{fast}
translation: 是啊，我不想当场决定。尤其是这么重要的事。{fast}

source: The decision is obvious!
translation: 这个决定显而易见！

source: But I feel like the decision should be obvious, Goro!
translation: 但我觉得这个决定应该很明显，Goro！

source: It sounds like it’d be great for the camp’s future!
translation: 听起来这对营地的未来会很棒！

source: Hmm, that may be so, but I’ve been down this road before.
translation: 嗯，也许是这样，但我以前走过这条路。

source: We shouldn't miss the chance.
translation: 我们不该错过这个机会。

source: We shouldn’t miss this chance, Goro!
translation: 我们不该错过这个机会，Goro！

source: It means more responsibilities.
translation: 这意味着更多责任。

source: I understand. It would mean bigger responsibilities.
translation: 我理解。这意味着更重大的责任。

source: Exactly. As big of an opportunity as it is for the camp, it also means heavy changes for us involved in management.
translation: 正是如此。这对营地来说是多大的机会，对我们这些参与管理的人而言，也意味着沉重的改变。

source: It's a huge change.
translation: 这是巨大的改变。

source: I understand.  It would mean heavy changes for all of us here at camp.
translation: 我理解。  这会给营地里的我们所有人带来沉重的改变。

source: Exactly. As big of an opportunity as it is for the camp, it also means bigger responsibilities that we may not be prepared for.
translation: 正是如此。这对营地来说是多大的机会，也意味着我们可能尚未准备好承担更重大的责任。

source: Ugh… Why am I doing this with you again…?
translation: 唉……我为什么又要和你一起做这个……？

source: Excuse me? I came with you to bring the scouts home AND waited on you to finish browsing that book store for HOURS!
translation: 你说什么？我陪你去送童子军回家，还等了你好几个小时，直到你逛完那家书店！

source: The least you could do is help me out!
translation: 你至少该帮我一下！

source: Fine, Fine…
translation: 好啦，好啦……

source: Oh, welcome back ladies. How was your drive?
translation: 哦，欢迎回来，女士们。路上开得怎么样？

source: Oh, don’t get me started! This pink thing was trying to get us killed with how reckless she is behind the wheel!
translation: 哦，别提了！这个粉毛开车那么莽，简直想害死我们！

source: Hey! It was fine until you started backseat driving!
translation: 喂！在你开始指挥我开车之前一切都很好！

source: Now, calm down both of you. Emilia, you’ve only just recovered.
translation: 好了，你们两个都冷静。Emilia，你才刚恢复。

source: Sorry I didn’t wake up in time though, Yuri. I was supposed to take the scouts home today.
translation: 不过抱歉我没能及时起床，Yuri。今天本该由我送童子军们回家。

source: It’s fine Yoshi! It’s been a while since I had some quality time with them anyway! Besides, Emilia wanted to get to know them too!
translation: 没事，Yoshi！反正我也有一段时间没和他们好好相处了！而且Emilia也想了解他们！

source: I-It’s not like that…!
translation: 不、不是那样的……！

source: Oh, don’t bother denying it! It’s okay to admit you like the scouts~
translation: 哦，别费心否认了！承认你喜欢童子军也没关系～

source: Haha, it’s good to see you two getting along better.
translation: 哈哈，很高兴看到你们两个相处得更好了。

source: What’s with all the empty boxes though? You girls packing something up?
translation: 不过这些空箱子是怎么回事？你们在打包什么吗？

source: Well, we just saw Mr. Clermont leave so we figured we could get some stuff out of the room now.
translation: 嗯，我们刚看到Clermont先生离开，所以觉得现在可以把一些东西从房间里搬出来。

source: Oh, right. Emilia stayed with you last night so Mr. Clermont could have a room.
translation: 哦，对。昨晚Emilia和你住在一起，好让Clermont先生有房间。

source: Yeah, and she liked it so much she’s gonna bunk with me from now on!
translation: 对，她很喜欢，所以从今以后要和我同住！

source: W-Wait, you and Emilia are gonna be permanent roommates?!
translation: 等、等等，你和Emilia要成为长期室友？！

source: Shocking, I know. But it was her decision.
translation: 很震惊，我知道。但这是她的决定。

source: Don’t make it sound like I begged you! It was a mutual agreement!
translation: 别说得像是我求你一样！这是双方同意的！

source: Yeah, yeah, whatever you say! Either way, I’m not gonna lie, it’s nice to finally have a girl I can hang out with for once!
translation: 是是是，随你怎么说！不管怎样，我不否认，终于有个能一起玩的女孩感觉真不错！

source: It takes me back to when we had that other all-girls branch Dad left me in charge of…
translation: 这让我想起以前爸爸让我负责的那个全女子分部……

source: Clearly, all this time with men affected your sense of fashion too. You barely have anything feminine in your wardrobe!
translation: 显然，整天和男人待在一起也影响了你的时尚品味。你的衣柜里几乎没有任何女性化的衣服！

source: Hey, speaking of that, you’re the messiest and sloppiest roommate ever! You dumped all my stuff on the floor!
translation: 嘿，说到这个，你是有史以来最乱、最邋遢的室友！你把我的东西全扔在地上！

source: Excuse me! I was trying to find the least drab outfit you own, turns out it was a hopeless cause!
translation: 你说什么！我想找出你拥有的最不土气的一套衣服，结果发现根本没希望！

source: You only got away with that because yesterday was a trial run.
translation: 你昨天能逃过一劫，只是因为那是试住。

source: Now that you’re officially moving in with me, there’s gonna be some house rules! Same goes for staying here at the camp!
translation: 现在你正式搬来和我住了，就得有些家规！住在营地也是一样！

source: *sigh* Fine…
translation: *叹气* 好吧……

source: Anyway, Dad! Now that Emilia is kicked out, you can use your room again~!
translation: 总之，爸爸！既然Emilia搬出去了，你又能用自己的房间了～！

source: Thank you for letting me use it over the last few months, sir.
translation: 谢谢您过去几个月让我使用它，先生。

source: Ah, you’re welcome…
translation: 啊，不客气……

source: I would understand if you wanted to stay in the cabin with the boys for a while longer, though.
translation: 不过，如果你想再和男孩们一起在小屋住一阵子，我也能理解。

source: You seem to be having fun with the them, so—
translation: 你看起来和他们相处得很开心，所以——

source: Hmm… I do think it’s a good idea to move back in.
translation: 嗯……我确实觉得搬回去是个好主意。

source: Wait, really?
translation: 等等，真的？

source: It was really nice having you in the scoutmaster’s quarters for a while.
translation: 有一段时间让你住在童子军团长的宿舍里，真的很不错。

source: Well, I’m not going alone. You’re coming with me.
translation: 嗯，我不会一个人搬。你和我一起。

source: The bed in my room is big enough for two people anyway.
translation: 反正我房间里的床够两个人睡。

source: Not only that, but we’re just one door away from the office. It’ll be more convenient for work.
translation: 不仅如此，我们和办公室只隔了一道门。工作会更方便。

source: And besides, the cabin is pretty cramped with six people sharing a room. They could use the extra space.
translation: 而且，六个人合住一间小屋实在太挤了。他们也能用上腾出的空间。

source: Plus, it’d be nice to have some privacy again.
translation: 再说，能重新有些私人空间也不错。

source: Right~ With Yoshinori.
translation: 对呀～和Yoshinori一起。

source: *ehem* Like I said, it’s to be more efficient.
translation: *咳哼* 就像我说的，这是为了提高效率。

source: Okay, if you say so~
translation: 好吧，既然你这么说～

source: Well, if you’re gonna move back in, Dad, then I’ll go tidy up the room for you!
translation: 嗯，既然你要搬回去，爸爸，那我去帮你收拾房间！

source: I suppose I’ll help as well. It IS my stuff after all.
translation: 我想我也会帮忙。毕竟那是我的东西。

source: I guess that gives us something to do today, Yoshinori.
translation: 我想这给我们找到了今天要做的事，Yoshinori。

source: Yeah, I’ll need to pack up my stuff as well!
translation: 是啊，我也得收拾我的东西！

source: Let’s go tell the others, then?
translation: 那我们去告诉其他人吧？

source: Alright, Goro!
translation: 好的，Goro！

source: Hehe, I didn’t know they were ‘that’ close.
translation: 嘿嘿，我不知道他们竟然“那么”亲近。

source: Huh?? What do you mean?
translation: 啊？？你是什么意思？

source: Aww… I will miss having you around, sir… Do you really have to leave us?
translation: 啊……我会想念您在身边的，先生……您真的非得离开我们吗？

source: Our nightly shenanigans won’t be the same without you!
translation: 没有您，我们夜晚的胡闹就不一样了！

source: I-I have grown really attached to Sir Goro over the months… It’s nice having a daddy— I mean, father figure…
translation: 这、这几个月里，我真的很依赖Goro先生……有个爸爸——我是说，父亲般的人物，感觉很好……

source: I know right?! I never got the chance to get to know Sir Goro this well when we were scouts!
translation: 对吧？！我们当童子军时，我从没机会这么深入地了解Goro先生！

source: Come on, guys. It’s not like Gramps is dying or anything!
translation: 拜托，伙计们。又不是Gramps要死了还是什么！

source: I know, I know! We just won’t spend as much time together if we aren’t roomies!
translation: 我知道，我知道！只是如果不当室友，我们就不会有那么多时间待在一起了！

source: Sir Goro wasn’t supposed to be bunking with us in the first place, Lloyd.
translation: Goro先生本来就不该和我们同住，Lloyd。

source: What about Yoshi…? Do you really have to go too?
translation: 那Yoshi呢……？你真的也要走吗？

source: Haha, yeah, sorry guys.
translation: 哈哈，是啊，抱歉了各位。

source: It’s not too surprising, though! Yoshi’s been helping Gramps with all the management stuff, so it’ll be easier if they stay together!
translation: 不过这也不算太意外！Yoshi一直在帮Gramps处理所有管理事务，所以他们住在一起会更方便！

source: Isn’t that right, Yoshi? *wink*
translation: 对吧，Yoshi？*眨眼*

source: Th-That’s right! It’ll be much more productive for both of us to stay close to the office! All the records are stored there after all!
translation: 没、没错！我们两个人住得靠近办公室会高效得多！毕竟所有档案都存在那里！

source: Don’t worry, everyone. We’ll still drop by here every now and then to hang out with you all.
translation: 别担心，大家。我们还是会时不时过来，和你们一起待着。

source: We’re both still going to be with you for meals and breaks too. The only change is where we’re sleeping.
translation: 我们也还是会和你们一起吃饭、休息。唯一的改变只是睡在哪里。

source: *sigh* I guess there’s no stopping you then…
translation: *叹气* 看来那就拦不住你们了……

source: Huhuhu… No more fortune-telling sessions and crystal healings in the morning either…
translation: 呜呜呜……早上也不能再算命和进行水晶疗愈了……

source: They’re literally next door, Lloyd.
translation: 他们就在隔壁，Lloyd。

source: Fine! But don’t be surprised when we crash the office whenever we want!
translation: 好吧！但等我们想什么时候就什么时候闯进办公室时，你们可别惊讶！

source: I don’t mind. It can get dull and quiet there easily.
translation: 我不介意。那里很容易变得无聊又安静。

source: Yay! Hear that, guys? We can bug them all the time now!
translation: 太好了！听到了吗，大家？我们现在可以一直去烦他们了！

source: You missed the whole point, Lloyd. They’re trying NOT to get distracted.
translation: 你完全弄错重点了，Lloyd。他们正是想不被打扰。

source: Y-Yeah, I wouldn’t want to bother you guys while you’re working, after all.
translation: 是、是啊，毕竟我也不想在你们工作时打扰你们。

source: Ahehe, don’t worry guys. We’ll make sure to balance out our time.
translation: 啊哈哈，别担心，各位。我们会确保平衡好时间。

source: Anyway, I think that should be all you guys’ stuff, right?
translation: 总之，我想这应该就是你们所有的东西了，对吧？

source: Ah, yes. Thank you for helping us pack. I still have most of my personal stuff stored in the shed, though.
translation: 啊，是的。谢谢你们帮我们收拾。不过，我大部分私人物品还放在棚屋里。

source: There wasn’t enough room in here, and I didn’t want to have Emilia share storage space with me in the room.
translation: 这里没有足够空间，而且我不想让Emilia在房间里和我共用储物空间。

source: Let us carry all this back to your room, Gramps! You can head over to the shed for your stuff!
translation: 让我们把这些全搬回您的房间吧，Gramps！您可以去棚屋拿您的东西！

source: Ah, that’s perfect. I appreciate all the help.
translation: 啊，那太好了。我很感谢大家的帮忙。

source: No problem, Gramps!
translation: 没问题，Gramps！

source: Come with me, Yoshinori.
translation: 跟我来，Yoshinori。

source: Right behind you!
translation: 马上跟上！

source: Huhuhu… I miss them already!
translation: 呜呜呜……我已经开始想念他们了！

source: It’s only been three seconds, Lloyd.
translation: 才过了三秒，Lloyd。

source: I don’t know if it’s just me, but… Doesn’t Sir Goro seem a bit closer to Yoshinori than everybody else…?
translation: 我不知道是不是只有我这么觉得，但是……Goro先生是不是比起其他人更亲近Yoshinori一些……？

source: Of course! They worked together the whole project, and they’ve always been a pair since we were scouts.
translation: 当然！整个项目都是他们一起做的，而且从我们当童子军起，他们一直就是一对搭档。

source: N-No, I mean… It’s different even compared to when I first joined.
translation: 不、不是，我是说……即使和我刚加入时相比，也不一样。

source: Sir Goro’s behavior completely changes around Yoshinori… He’s a lot more… I don’t know… personal?
translation: Goro先生在Yoshinori身边的行为完全变了……他更……我不知道……更私人化？

source: Yes, I did notice that. When Yoshinori became his assistant, when we were on a vacation, and even more now.
translation: 是的，我确实注意到了。从Yoshinori成为他的助手、我们一起度假时，到现在更是如此。

source: Huh… he does seem pretty clingy, huh?
translation: 嗯……他看起来确实很黏人，对吧？

source: Hehe, you guys are just overthinking it~
translation: 嘿嘿，你们只是想太多了～

source: Now come on, these boxes won’t move themselves!
translation: 好了，来吧，这些箱子可不会自己移动！

source: That should be all of it!
translation: 应该全都在这儿了！

source: That’s… a lot of stuff, Goro… All of this came from your room…?
translation: 这……东西真多，Goro……这些全都是从你的房间搬出来的……？

source: Well, some of it’s already been stored in here for a couple years now. I figured it was time to bring it all back inside.
translation: 嗯，其中一些已经在这里存放好几年了。我觉得该把它们都搬回里面了。

source: Actually, that’s one of the reasons I dragged you with me, I wanted to show you something.
translation: 其实，那也是我把你拉来的原因之一，我想给你看些东西。

source: Oh, now I’m curious! What’s in these boxes, anyway?
translation: 哦，现在我好奇了！这些箱子里到底是什么？

source: Hmm, it’s mostly stuff from my past that I stopped looking back at.
translation: 嗯，大多是我过去的东西，我已经不再回头看它们了。

source: I can’t remember the last time I opened this one.
translation: 我已经不记得上次打开这个是什么时候了。

source: Yeah… It looks like it’s collected a lot of dust!
translation: 是啊……看来它积了不少灰！

source: Ah, here they are!
translation: 啊，在这里！

source: Oh, these are pictures from way back…!
translation: 哦，这些是很久以前的照片……！

source: Yes, and this one in particular is the first time I took Yuri camping.
translation: 是的，尤其是这一张，是我第一次带Yuri去露营时拍的。

source: You both look so happy here!
translation: 你们两个在这里看起来好开心！

source: We were, but things weren’t so great before this moment…
translation: 我们当时确实很开心，但在这之前事情并不那么好……

source: What do you mean, sir…?
translation: 您是什么意思，先生……？

source: When Yuri was growing up, she didn’t have the best environment at home…
translation: Yuri成长时，家里的环境并不算好……

source: As the family’s breadwinner, I was often away from home, leaving Yuri to spend time with her mother.
translation: 作为家庭的经济支柱，我经常不在家，只能让Yuri和她母亲待在一起。

source: She and her mother didn’t get along, and all Yuri saw when we were together was her parents arguing…
translation: 她和母亲相处不好，而Yuri看到的只有父母在一起时争吵……

source: It started affecting her studies… and even her overall demeanor changed thanks to all the pent-up frustrations…
translation: 这开始影响她的学业……积压的挫折感甚至改变了她整体的性情……

source: I realized that I had to take over and find a way to give Yuri the childhood she deserved.
translation: 我意识到自己必须承担起来，想办法给Yuri应得的童年。

source: And that’s when I started making more time for her as a father.
translation: 于是，我开始以父亲的身份为她腾出更多时间。

source: When I first took her out camping with me, she was so thrilled, and everything about her lit up like I hadn’t seen in years.
translation: 我第一次带她去露营时，她兴奋极了，她整个人焕发出的光彩是我多年未见的。

source: We both had a passion for adventure and loved the idea of doing those same activities together with the people we loved.
translation: 我们都热爱冒险，也喜欢和所爱的人一起做那些活动的想法。

source: Now that we had something in common, I continued taking her out more and more, until I realized…
translation: 既然我们有了共同点，我便越来越常带她出门，直到我意识到……

source: I wanted it to last forever… not only for her, but for the both of us.
translation: 我想让它永远持续下去……不仅为了她，也为了我们两个人。

source: That’s when I started working harder… I wanted to save enough money to make that dream a reality.
translation: 从那时起我开始更加努力工作……我想存下足够的钱，让那个梦想成为现实。

source: Wait… Do you mean that—
translation: 等等……您的意思是——

source: Yes, that’s how Camp Buddy was born.
translation: 是的，伙伴营地就是这样诞生的。

source: Wow… That’s really heartwarming…
translation: 哇……这真的很暖心……

source: The road to get there wasn’t easy at all, and it was only possible because Yuri was with me every step of the way.
translation: 走到那一步的路一点也不容易，只有因为Yuri一路陪在我身边才成为可能。

source: You can imagine just how happy we both were to launch the very first term and finally get to share our dream with everyone else. With you.
translation: 你可以想象，当我们启动第一期、终于能和其他所有人分享梦想时，我们两人有多么高兴。包括你在内。

source: I can’t believe that’s how everything really started…
translation: 我不敢相信原来一切真的是这样开始的……

source: Haha, now you know the real history.
translation: 哈哈，现在你知道真正的历史了。

source: This place’s legacy is something that I want you to carry into the future, and share with others, too.
translation: 我想让你把这个地方的传承带向未来，也和其他人分享。

source: It’s an honor to be a part of all this… I’ll try my hardest to make Camp Buddy the best it can be.
translation: 能参与这一切是我的荣幸……我会竭尽全力让伙伴营地变得最好。

source: I know you will… But that’s not all I wanted to show you…
translation: 我知道你会的……但我想给你看的不止这些……

source: Oh my god… Is that who I think it is?!
translation: 天啊……那是我想的那个人吗？！

source: Yeah, that’s me, Vera, and a very tiny Yuri.
translation: 是啊，那是我、Vera，还有非常小的Yuri。

source: Yuri really takes after her mother, doesn't she?
translation: Yuri真的很像她母亲，不是吗？

source: Yeah… Although I barely recognized you, Goro…
translation: 是啊……虽然我几乎认不出你了，Goro……

source: Well, Yuri was only two here. That makes me twenty-two around this time…
translation: 嗯，Yuri在这里才两岁。那时我大约二十二岁……

source: I-It’s not just that you look young, sir… even the way you dressed seems so out of character.
translation: 不、不只是您看起来年轻，先生……就连您的穿衣方式也显得很不像您。

source: Well, having a child changed my life forever. I was striving for the perfect family and did my best to be an ideal father and husband.
translation: 嗯，有了孩子永远改变了我的人生。我努力追求一个完美的家庭，尽我所能成为理想的父亲和丈夫。

source: Looking back, I really thought everything would go the way I imagined as long as I kept doing things the 'proper’ way.
translation: 回头看，我真的以为只要一直按“正确”的方式做事，一切都会如我想象的那样发展。

source: Eventually, I realized that I was raising my daughter on my own, and that Vera and I lacked the foundation to be a proper couple.
translation: 最终，我意识到自己正在独自抚养女儿，而Vera和我缺乏成为一对真正伴侣的基础。

source: I honestly can’t believe I managed it; we were both so young for all that responsibility.
translation: 说实话，我不敢相信自己熬过来了；承担那些责任时，我们两个都太年轻。

source: Most people that age were focused on taking care of themselves, and I don’t blame Vera for it. But I had to step up for Yuri’s sake.
translation: 那个年纪的大多数人都专注于照顾自己，我不怪Vera。但为了Yuri，我必须挺身而出。

source: Most people that age were focused on taking care of themselves, and I don’t blame Vera for it. But I had to step up for Yuri’s sake.{fast}
translation: 那个年纪的大多数人都专注于照顾自己，我不怪Vera。但为了Yuri，我必须挺身而出。{fast}

source: You deserved better.
translation: 你本应得到更好的。

source: You really deserved better…
translation: 你真的本该得到更好的……

source: That’s not the point.
translation: 重点不在这里。

source: Regardless of my past, I’m happy where I am today.
translation: 不管我的过去如何，我对今天的生活很满足。

source: It must've been so difficult.
translation: 那一定非常困难。

source: It must’ve been so difficult to make all those sacrifices.
translation: 做出那么多牺牲一定非常困难。

source: It was. But I don’t regret them.
translation: 确实如此。但我不后悔。

source: You're in a good place now.
translation: 你现在过得很好。

source: You’re in a good place now thanks to all the sacrifices you’ve made.
translation: 多亏了你做出的所有牺牲，你现在过得很好。

source: Yes. I’m happy where I am in life. My past made me who I am today.
translation: 是的。我对现在的人生很满足。我的过去造就了今天的我。

source: It made you who you are today.
translation: 它造就了今天的你。

source: The past made you who you are today.
translation: 过去造就了今天的你。

source: Yes. And I’m thankful for it. I can finally say I’m happy where I am in life.
translation: 是的。而我很感激它。我终于可以说，我对现在的人生很满足。

source: Even though I’ve known you for so long, there’s still so many things I’m learning about you…
translation: 尽管我认识你这么久了，还是有那么多关于你的事等着我去了解……

source: Heh, speaking of… I still want to show you one last picture.
translation: 呵，说到这个……我还想给你看最后一张照片。

source: Whoa…!
I know I told you I’d only talk about this once, but…
translation: 我知道我告诉过你只会谈这件事一次，但是……

source: I figured I’d show you what I looked like during my biker days rather than just leaving it to your imagination.
translation: 我想，与其只让你凭想象，不如让你看看我骑手时代的样子。

source: This looks even better than what I imagined…!
translation: 这看起来比我想象的还要好……！

source: That outfit and the bike behind you… You look so handsome, sir!
translation: 那套衣服和你身后的摩托车……您看起来太帅了，先生！

source: Haha, I thought I looked so cool and tough wearing all that grunge and leather.
translation: 哈哈，我以为穿着那些朋克和皮革装束的自己看起来很酷、很硬汉。

source: But you really were, sir! How long ago was this?
translation: 但您当时真的就是那样，先生！这是多久以前的事？

source: This was way before I had my family, even before I met my wife.
translation: 这是在我组建家庭之前，甚至在我认识妻子之前很久的事。

source: Heh… I remember I’d spend all my time and money customizing my bike, then showing it off to the gang.
translation: 呵……我记得我会把所有时间和钱花在改装摩托车上，然后向帮派伙伴炫耀。

source: It’s crazy how different my priorities were back then.
translation: 那时我的优先事项和现在截然不同，真不可思议。

source: But you really look like you’re having fun here, sir!
translation: 但您在这里看起来真的很开心，先生！

source: Where’s your bike now, Goro?
translation: 你的摩托车现在在哪儿，Goro？

source: I gave it to a friend, when I had Yuri. But I still have the original keys with me.
translation: 有了Yuri时，我把它送给了一位朋友。但原来的钥匙还在我这里。

source: In fact, I still have all my outfit and old stuff in the other boxes.
translation: 事实上，我所有的服装和旧物还都在其他箱子里。

source: In fact, I still have all my outfit and old stuff in the other boxes.{fast}
translation: 事实上，我所有的服装和旧物还都在其他箱子里。{fast}

source: It was time to move on.
translation: 是时候向前走了。

source: I guess that makes sense… It was time to move on then.
translation: 我想这很有道理……那时确实该向前走了。

source: But don’t you miss having it?
translation: 但你不怀念拥有它吗？

source: Of course, I do. Maybe one day I’ll get it back, if he still has it.
translation: 当然怀念。也许有一天，如果他还留着它，我会把它拿回来。

source: Giving it up must've been hard.
translation: 放弃它一定很难。

source: Giving it up must’ve been hard…
translation: 放弃它一定很难……

source: It was, but it was the right thing to do.
translation: 确实很难，但那是正确的做法。

source: Maybe one day I’ll be able to get it back though, if he still has it.
translation: 不过，也许有一天，如果他还留着它，我能把它拿回来。

source: I want to see you wear it again.
translation: 我想再看你穿上它。

source: Oh, I’d love to see you wear the outfit!
translation: 哦，我很想看你穿上那套服装！

source: I won’t deny, I would love to put it on and go for a ride again.
translation: 我不否认，我很想再穿上它去骑一次车。

source: Maybe you could go get it back from that friend!
translation: 也许你可以从那位朋友那里把它拿回来！

source: Haha, one day, perhaps!
translation: 哈哈，也许有一天吧！

source: Take me on a ride one day.
translation: 有一天带我去兜风吧。

source: Maybe one day you can get the bike back… and take me on a ride!
translation: 也许有一天你可以把摩托车拿回来……然后带我去兜风！

source: Hahaha! That eager to make me relive my glory days, huh?
translation: 哈哈哈！这么急着让我重温辉煌岁月啊？

source: I won’t deny I would love to ride again - one day, perhaps!
translation: 我不否认自己很想再骑一次——也许有一天吧！

source: Man, you were doing all these cool things, and I was learning how to knit patches when I was that age… I feel so lame all of a sudden.
translation: 天啊，你那个年纪在做这些酷事，而我那时在学怎么织徽章……我突然觉得自己好逊。

source: I can’t believe how we lived such opposite lives, Goro…
translation: 我不敢相信我们的生活曾如此截然相反，Goro……

source: And yet here we are. Going against all odds.
translation: 而我们如今却在这里。跨越了一切阻碍。

source: After everything I’ve learned…  Can I ask why you wanted to show me all this, Goro?
translation: 在了解了这一切之后……  我可以问问你为什么想给我看这些吗，Goro？

source: For the longest time, I kept all of these memories locked away, thinking it was what I needed in order to change…
translation: 很长一段时间里，我把这些回忆都封存起来，以为那是自己为了改变所需要做的事……

source: Back then, I wouldn’t even dare to look at this myself, let alone show it to someone else.
translation: 那时，我连自己都不敢看这些，更别说展示给别人。

source: But now it just feels liberating… it’s making me realize how far I’ve come.
translation: 但现在这只让我感到解脱……它让我意识到自己已经走了多远。

source: After what happened back at the hotel, I realized that I don’t need to bury my past anymore.
translation: 酒店发生那件事后，我意识到自己不再需要埋葬过去。

source: I may have given up a lot of things, but I’ve also earned more than I ever hoped for.
translation: 我也许放弃了很多东西，但我也得到了比曾经希望的更多。

source: Camp Buddy… This family we built… And you.
translation: 伙伴营地……我们建立的这个家庭……还有你。

source: Not only that, but my delinquent days were also a joyful time of my life… They’re a genuine part of who I am.
translation: 不仅如此，我那段不良少年时期也是人生中快乐的时光……它们是我真实的一部分。

source: I know I’ve said this a lot already, but thank you for encouraging me to not be ashamed of my past and…
translation: 我知道我已经说过很多次了，但谢谢你鼓励我不要为过去感到羞耻，还……

source: Teaching me to be myself again…
translation: 教会我再次做回自己……

source: But you did that yourself...! You were the one who’s opened up to me on your own.
translation: 但那是你自己做到的……！是你主动向我敞开心扉。

source: I was only able to help because you let me…
translation: 我能帮上忙，只是因为你允许我这么做……

source: *ehem* I didn’t mean for this to get so cheesy.
translation: *咳哼* 我没想让这变得这么肉麻。

source: Anyway, that’s all of the interesting stuff for now, I can show you the other pictures after we carry all this to our room.
translation: 总之，目前有趣的东西就这些了，等我们把这些搬到房间后，我可以给你看其他照片。

source: Haha, alright! I want to see more photos of you with your bike!
translation: 哈哈，好啊！我还想看更多你和摩托车的照片！

source: {i}Goro and I carried everything into our room and spent the rest of the day unpacking and chatting casually about his things.{/i}
translation: {i}Goro和我把所有东西搬进房间，用一天余下的时间拆包，并轻松地聊着他的物品。{/i}

source: {i}Goro has come such a long way to be able to be so open with me… It’s like the floodgates have opened and he’s so excited to tell me all about his life.{/i}
translation: {i}Goro走了很长的路，才能这样对我敞开心扉……就像闸门打开了一样，他兴奋地想告诉我关于他人生的一切。{/i}

source: {i}I’m so happy I get to be a part of it!{/i}
translation: {i}我很高兴自己能成为其中的一部分！{/i}

source: Eyyy! The guests of honor are finally here!
translation: 嘿嘿！主宾终于来了！

source: Huh? What’s going on here?
translation: 嗯？这里在做什么？

source: Come here, Dad! Sit with us~!
translation: 过来，爸爸！和我们坐一起～！

source: So, what’s with the sudden party?
translation: 那么，这场突然的派对是怎么回事？

source: Well, since it’s you two’s last day in our cabin, we thought we should take the chance to send you off with a bang!
translation: 嗯，既然今天是你们两个在我们小屋的最后一天，我们觉得该抓住机会热热闹闹地为你们送行！

source: We’ll really miss you guys! Boo hoo!
translation: 我们真的会想念你们的！呜呜！

source: Is that really the reason…?
translation: 真的是这个原因吗……？

source: Didn’t we just have a party last night? This seems like an excuse to have another one.
translation: 我们昨晚不是刚办过派对吗？这看起来像是再办一场的借口。

source: It is. But Lloyd and I also finished up the repairs today, so we wanted to celebrate.
translation: 就是这样。但Lloyd和我今天也完成了修缮，所以我们想庆祝一下。

source: Yeah! Let’s get in one last hurrah together before the workers get back!
translation: 是啊！在工人回来前，我们一起最后狂欢一次吧！

source: Hehe~ It’s nothing too fancy, just a little drinking session to make us all feel warm and fuzzy inside!
translation: 嘿嘿～没什么特别的，只是一场小小的饮酒会，让我们心里都暖洋洋、软乎乎的！

source: What?! There’s more alcohol?!
translation: 什么？！还有酒？！

source: I’m surprised you let everyone drink again, Yuri… Even the scouts…
translation: 我很惊讶你又让大家喝酒了，Yuri……连童子军也……

source: Hey! We’re not scouts right now, we work here just like y’all!
translation: 嘿！我们现在不是童子军，我们和你们一样在这里工作！

source: YEAH! Pass over the booze already!
translation: 对啊！快把酒递过来！

source: *sigh* I guess it wouldn’t hurt to hang out together one more time…
translation: *叹气* 我想再一起待一次也没什么坏处……

source: Well, I’m down. Yoshinori, you’re getting drunk tonight.
translation: 嗯，我参加。Yoshinori，你今晚要喝醉。

source: Gah! I can’t afford to have a hangover tomorrow!
translation: 啊！我明天可不能宿醉！

source: Heh, better work on your tolerance then.
translation: 呵，那你最好练练酒量。

source: Now that I think about it… I don’t think I’ve ever heard of a workplace that parties this much together…
translation: 现在想想……我好像从没听说过哪个工作场所会这么常一起开派对……

source: Ugh! I know right?! It’s like we’re not in the middle of a project!
translation: 唉！就是啊？！就好像我们不是在项目进行中一样！

source: You say that as you gulp down that shot.
translation: 你一口闷掉那杯酒时却这么说。

source: Hmph, I’m just trying to fit in with the group.
translation: 哼，我只是在努力融入大家。

source: Jeez, where was this Emilia back at the hotel?
translation: 天啊，酒店里的那个Emilia去哪儿了？

source: Really? We’re going through this again?
translation: 真的吗？我们又要说这事？

source: Anywayyyy since it’s a party, let’s play a game while we drink!
translation: 总之既然是派对，我们边喝边玩个游戏吧！

source: Oooh! Party games! Me likey!
translation: 哦哦！派对游戏！我喜欢！

source: Party games? Like musical chairs? What are we, five?
translation: 派对游戏？比如抢椅子？我们五岁吗？

source: Obviously Emilia here hasn’t gotten a taste of how we do things at Camp Buddy.
translation: 显然这里的Emilia还没见识过伙伴营地是怎么玩的。

source: Things get spicy when you’re tipsy~
translation: 微醺时事情会变得火辣～

source: Hihihi~ I like where you’re going with this, Aiden~
translation: 嘻嘻嘻～我喜欢你的思路，Aiden～

source: *sigh* Count me out.
translation: *叹气* 别算我。

source: S-Spicy you say…?!
translation: 火、火辣，你说……？！

source: Now, since Yoshi and Gramps are our special guests, why don’t we give ’em the honor of picking what game we play?
translation: 现在，既然Yoshi和Gramps是我们的特别来宾，为什么不把选择玩什么游戏的荣誉交给他们？

source: It’s your choice, Yoshinori.
translation: 由你选择，Yoshinori。

source: It’s your choice, Yoshinori.{fast}
translation: 由你选择，Yoshinori。{fast}

source: Never have I ever.
translation: 我从没做过。

source: Truth or dare.
translation: 真心话大冒险。

source: Rock-Paper-Scissors.
translation: 石头剪刀布。

source: Picture Charades.
translation: 看图猜词。

source: I guess let’s try ‘Never Have I Ever.’ How does it work again exactly?
translation: 我想我们试试“我从没做过”吧。具体是怎么玩来着？

source: Oh, it’s easy! You go around the room and take turns saying something you’ve never done!
translation: 哦，很简单！大家轮流说一件自己从没做过的事！

source: If anyone else has done it, they lose a point, and if they lose three points then they’re out!
translation: 如果其他人做过那件事，就失去一分；失去三分就出局！

source: Sounds simple enough.
translation: 听起来够简单。

source: Alright! Let’s start then!
translation: 好！那就开始吧！

source: You’ll have to count me out of this one, Yuri! I gotta make some snacks for us real quick!
translation: 这次得别算我，Yuri！我得赶紧给大家做些零食！

source: Plus, I think I’d probably lose pretty quickly, hehe.
translation: 而且，我觉得自己大概会很快输掉，嘿嘿。

source: Aww, come on, Aiden! I have some theories I wanted to test on you!
translation: 啊，拜托，Aiden！我有些理论想在你身上验证！

source: Eugh, on that note, I’m coming with you, Aiden.
translation: 呃，说到这个，我和你一起去，Aiden。

source: Eh?! What for?
translation: 咦？！为什么？

source: You need somebody to help with the snacks, and it IS my job now, after all.
translation: 你需要有人帮忙做零食，而且这毕竟也是我现在的工作。

source: Haha, alright then! We’ll be right back!
translation: 哈哈，好吧！我们马上回来！

source: Hey! You two are just trying to sneak the food for yourselves!
translation: 嘿！你们两个只是想偷偷把食物留给自己！

source: Ugh, I’d better make sure he doesn’t harass them too much. I’m out too.
translation: 唉，我最好确保他不会太骚扰他们。我也不玩。

source: WHAT?! That’s half of us out already, no fair!
translation: 什么？！已经有一半人退出了，不公平！

source: Haha, don’t worry, Yuri, the rest of us will play with you.
translation: 哈哈，别担心，Yuri，剩下的人会陪你玩。

source: Hmmm… alright. I guess I can still get some good info out of all of you.
translation: 嗯……好吧。我想我还是能从你们所有人那里得到些有用信息。

source: Pfft…!
Y-Yuri!
translation: 尤、Yuri！

source: *sigh* I should’ve guessed that’d be her first question.
translation: *叹气* 我早该猜到那会是她的第一个问题。

source: Lloyd and I lost a point.
translation: Lloyd和我失去一分。

source: D-Dar! Don’t throw me under the bus like that!
translation: 达、Dar！别这样把我拖下水！

source: Interestiiiing~ So that answers that for Darius and Lloyd. The rest of you, speak up!
translation: 有意思～所以Darius和Lloyd的答案出来了。你们其他人，说话！

source: I-I still keep my points…
translation: 我、我还保住了分数……

source: Aww, Jin! Don’t worry, there’s still a few months of the project left to get some action~
translation: 啊，Jin！别担心，项目还剩几个月，足够你找点激情～

source: *gulp* W-With who…?
translation: *咽口水* 和、和谁……？

source: Yoshinori and I lose a point.
translation: Yoshinori和我失去一分。

source: G-Gah!
translation: 啊、啊！

source: Oh, really? I guess I wouldn’t exist if Dad didn’t. Who was yours with, Yoshi?
translation: 哦，真的？我想如果爸爸没有发生过，我就不会存在。你是和谁，Yoshi？

source: *ehem* I-I don’t think that was the question, Yuri.
translation: *咳哼* 我、我不觉得那是问题本身，Yuri。

source: Hmph. Fine, then it’s your go next, Yoshi.
translation: 哼。好吧，那接下来轮到你了，Yoshi。

source: O-Oh, alright! Hmmm… Let me think.
translation: 哦、哦，好吧！嗯……让我想想。

source: Never have I ever… Been on vacation with someone here!
translation: 我从没……和这里的某个人一起度过假！

source: Come on, Yoshi! Do better than that!
translation: 拜托，Yoshi！说个更好的！

source: E-Eh, why?
translation: 咦、咦，为什么？

source: We literally all just went on a vacation together, Yoshinori…
translation: 我们才刚刚一起度过假，Yoshinori……

source: O-Oh, right… Oops.
translation: 哦、哦，对……哎呀。

source: I’ll try next. I have the perfect one.
translation: 下个我来。我有个绝佳的问题。

source: Hehe… Never have I ever had a crush on someone during the first term.
translation: 嘿嘿……我从没在第一期时暗恋过某个人。

source: Not me~
translation: 不是我～

source: I-I wasn’t even here the first term…
translation: 我、我第一期时根本不在这里……

source: This is no fair! It’s like you guys are targeting me and Dar!
translation: 这不公平！你们就像是在针对我和Dar！

source: You just outed me.
translation: 你刚刚把我出柜了。

source: KYAAAA! You two are so cuuuute~!
translation: 呀啊啊啊！你们两个太可爱了～！

source: Well, I… lost a point, too
translation: 嗯，我……也失去一分。

source: Again, that’s not the game, Yuri.
translation: 再说一次，那不是游戏内容，Yuri。

source: Well, it looks like Yoshi, Lloyd, and Darius only have only one point left now, so they might lose!
translation: 嗯，看起来Yoshi、Lloyd和Darius现在都只剩一分了，所以他们可能会输！

source: It’s your turn, Jin, and you better not bully us!
translation: 轮到你了，Jin，你最好别欺负我们！

source: I-I do have something I’ve been dying to know.
translation: 我、我确实有件非常想知道的事。

source: Hihi, this one ought to be good~
translation: 嘻嘻，这个肯定不错～

source: That’s the same thing Yuri said!
translation: 这和Yuri说的一样！

source: ...in the scoutmaster cabin while others were around.
translation: ……趁其他人也在附近时，在童军团长宿舍里做过。

source: KYAA! Perfect question for our departures theme tonight~!
translation: 呀啊！今晚的主题正好是搬家，这问题太应景了～！

source: Obviously I don’t stay with you guys, so, no! Alright, speak up, all of you!
translation: 我又不跟你们住，当然没有！好了，你们全都老实交代！

source: Not me.
translation: 不是我。

source: Me neither…!
translation: 我也没有……！

source: How about you, Lloyd and Darius?!
translation: 那你们呢，Lloyd和Darius？！

source: We’re both out.
translation: 我们两个都出局了。

source: So that was you two I heard last night…
translation: 所以我昨晚听到的是你们两个……

source: WHAT?! TELL ME THE DETAILS!
translation: 什么？！告诉我细节！

source: No fair! You guys already know how Dar and I are, so you picked those questions on purpose!
translation: 不公平！你们早就知道我和Dar的情况，所以故意挑这些问题！

source: I-I don’t think that was our intent, Lloyd…
translation: 我、我不觉得那是我们的本意，Lloyd……

source: Oh yeah?! Then how do you explain the rest of you having so many points left?!
translation: 哦，是吗？！那你怎么解释其他人还剩这么多分？！

source: Relax, Lloyd. It’s not serious.
translation: 冷静，Lloyd。这不严重。

source: What?! What do you mean ‘Not serious’?!
translation: 什么？！你说“不严重”是什么意思？！

source: ‘Sirius’, hehe.
translation: “Sirius”，嘿嘿。

source: I’m not joking! What’s wrong with you, Dar?!
translation: 我不是在开玩笑！你怎么回事，Dar？！

source: Oh no. What did I say…?
translation: 哦不。我说错什么了……？

source: It’s what you didn’t say!
translation: 是你没说出来的事！

source: Uhh…
We’ve been together long enough, haven’t we? I take this relationship seriously!
translation: 我们在一起够久了，不是吗？我很认真对待这段关系！

source: I think you misunderstood…
translation: 我想你误会了……

source: Gah! Nevermind! I’m just going to get some snacks!
translation: 啊！算了！我去拿些零食！

source: Hold on. Let’s talk!
translation: 等等。我们谈谈！

source: Wh-What was that about?
translation: 那、那是怎么回事？

source: Hehe, looks like a lover’s quarrel~
translation: 嘿嘿，看来是恋人吵架～

source: Hngh… Now I feel bad…
translation: 唔……我现在觉得很愧疚……

source: Hmmm, I wonder if they’re struggling to find a label.
translation: 嗯，我想知道他们是不是在为关系定义而苦恼。

source: Wh-What?! Where are you guys getting all that?!
translation: 什、什么？！你们都是从哪里得出这些的？！

source: Seriously, Yoshi? Read the room!
translation: 认真的，Yoshi？看看气氛！

source: I-It was pretty obvious…
translation: 这、这已经很明显了……

source: Now, come on! Yoshi has one point left, and I’m gonna make the most of it! It’s my turn again!
translation: 好了，来吧！Yoshi只剩一分，我要好好利用！又轮到我了！

source: {i}We finished the round, and eventually Lloyd and Darius came back.{/i}
translation: {i}我们结束了这一轮，最终Lloyd和Darius回来了。{/i}

source: {i}We were glad that they seem to have calmed down, and rejoined the game.{/i}
translation: {i}他们似乎已经冷静下来并重新加入游戏，我们很高兴。{/i}

source: {i}Eventually, Aiden, Emilia, Yoichi and Taiga came back with snacks, and we all kept partying for the rest of the evening!{/i}
translation: {i}最后，Aiden、Emilia、Yoichi和Taiga带着零食回来，我们整个晚上剩下的时间都在继续派对！{/i}

source: Let’s play Truth or Dare! It really takes me back to our scout days, haha!
translation: 我们玩真心话大冒险吧！这真的让我想起当童子军的日子，哈哈！

source: KYAAA! That’s a great idea, Yoshi! I can’t wait to ‘dare’ everyone!
translation: 呀啊啊！好主意，Yoshi！我等不及要给每个人出“大冒险”了！

source: We’re game too! It’s called Truth or DAR after all, ehhhhhhhhh?
translation: 我们也玩！毕竟这叫真心话或DAR冒险嘛，懂不懂啊啊啊啊？

source: That was lame.
translation: 这太烂了。

source: I’ll start! Yoshi, truth or dare! I pick dare!
translation: 我先来！Yoshi，真心话还是大冒险！我选大冒险！

source: Umm… Am I not supposed to be the one to pick?
translation: 嗯……不该由我来选吗？

source: KYAAA!! Now, I have this box in the shed—
translation: 呀啊啊！！现在，我在棚屋里有个箱子——

source: Nothing inappropriate, Yuri.
translation: 别出不合适的题，Yuri。

source: Whaaaaat?! That takes out all the fun! BOOO! You guys are boring!!!
translation: 什么啊啊啊？！那就完全没意思了！嘘！你们太无聊了！！！

source: A-Ah well…. I guess I-I don’t mind playing a bit risky.
translation: 啊、啊，嗯……我想我、我不介意玩得稍微大胆一点。

source: See, Dad?! Yoshi doesn’t mind!
translation: 看吧，爸爸？！Yoshi不介意！

source: Now, Yoshi! I need you to take your shirt off!
translation: 现在，Yoshi！我要你脱掉上衣！

source: Do it, Yoshinori.
translation: 照做，Yoshinori。

source: Sheesh, Sir Goro changed his mind about that real quick, huh?
translation: 唉呀，Goro先生这么快就改变主意了，对吧？

source: Soooo? Are you gonna be a man of your word, Yoshi?
translation: 所——以？Yoshi，你会说到做到吗？

source: Ugh fine…
translation: 唉，好吧……

source: There.
translation: 好了。

source: Bara tiddies…
translation: 壮男胸……

source: Now squish them together and say ‘Want some milk, daddy?’!
translation: 现在把它们挤在一起，说“想喝点奶吗，爸爸？”！

source: NO WAY!
translation: 绝对不行！

source: Sir Goro seems to disagree.
translation: Goro先生似乎不这么认为。

source: *ehem* How did we end up with this conversation…?
translation: *咳哼* 我们怎么会聊到这个……？

source: I-It’s literally one of my top ten fantasies…
translation: 这、这真的是我的十大幻想之一……

source: Right?! The fanfics are writing themselves!
translation: 对吧？！同人小说都自己写出来了！

source: Come on! Enough distractions, back to the game you two!
translation: 来吧！分心够多了，你们两个回到游戏！

source: W-Well, I guess it your turn then, Lloyd. Truth or dare?
translation: 嗯、嗯，我想那就轮到你了，Lloyd。真心话还是大冒险？

source: Oh, oh! I wanna pick dare!
translation: 哦，哦！我想选大冒险！

source: Someone’s brave.
translation: 有人很勇敢嘛。

source: If that’s the case, then Yoshi wants you to make out with Darius!
translation: 既然这样，Yoshi要你和Darius热吻！

source: Y-Yuri! You stole my turn…!
translation: 尤、Yuri！你抢了我的回合……！

source: Where’s your courage now, Little Lloyd~?
translation: 你的勇气去哪儿了，小Lloyd～？

source: You don’t have to do it, you guys. Let me pick another dare-
translation: 你们不用做，伙计们。让我换一个大冒险——

source: I’m down!
translation: 我愿意！

source: *smooches Darius*
translation: *亲吻Darius*

source: *screaming*
translation: *尖叫*

source: Th-There! That’s all you're getting!
translation: 好、好了！你就只能得到这些！

source: *licks lips*
translation: *舔嘴唇*

source: Hey! You didn’t even use your tongues!
translation: 嘿！你们甚至都没用舌头！

source: Looks like the alcohol’s certainly doing the trick, huh…?
translation: 看来酒精确实起作用了，对吧……？

source: *huff, huff* I-I think I need a toilet break…
translation: *喘气，喘气* 我、我想我需要去趟厕所……

source: Oh no, you don’t! It’s your turn, Jin!
translation: 哦，不，你不需要！轮到你了，Jin！

source: G-Gah! Why me?!
translation: 啊、啊！为什么是我？！

source: Because I’m tired of you getting to just react over there! It’s your turn!
translation: 因为我受够你在那边只顾着反应！轮到你了！

source: Truth or dare! Better think carefully!
translation: 真心话还是大冒险！最好仔细想想！

source: Go with the dare, Jin!! Your heart wants it too!!
translation: 选大冒险，Jin！！你的心也想选它！！

source: *gulp* A-Although I’m curious about the dare, I’ll go with truth…
translation: *咽口水* 虽、虽然我对大冒险很好奇，我还是选真心话……

source: Good choice. If you’d said dare, I’d have had you sitting on Yoshi’s lap!
translation: 选得好。如果你选大冒险，我会让你坐到Yoshi腿上！

source: *splutters* WHAAAAAT?!
translation: *呛到* 什么啊啊啊啊？！

source: I TAKE IT BACK! LET ME OVER THERE!
translation: 我收回！让我坐过去！

source: Off limits! Private property!
translation: 禁止接近！私人财产！

source: And you already said truth, so no takebacks.
translation: 而且你已经说了真心话，所以不能反悔。

source: *clears throat* What was your question, Lloyd?
translation: *清嗓子* 你的问题是什么，Lloyd？

source: Alright, Jin! Have you ever ACTUALLY been with another guy?! You’re always going on and on about all these fantasies, but you gotta have experienced at least one, right!
translation: 好，Jin！你真的和另一个男人交往过吗？！你总是不停说这些幻想，但至少总该亲身经历过一次吧！

source: O-Oh, well…
translation: 哦、哦，嗯……

source: A-Ah, you don’t have to answer if you don’t want to, Jin!
translation: 啊、啊，如果你不想回答也不用，Jin！

source: Bad boy, Lloyd.
translation: 坏孩子，Lloyd。

source: WHAT?! I didn’t mean it like that! I just wanted to know!
translation: 什么？！我不是那个意思！我只是想知道！

source: N-No, it’s alright…! It’s a fair question.
translation: 不、不会，没关系……！这是个合理的问题。

source: B-But the answer is no… I haven’t.
translation: 但、但是答案是否……我没有。

source: Really? I’m a bit surprised, Jin. You’re a really handsome guy, after all.
translation: 真的？我有点惊讶，Jin。毕竟你是个非常帅的家伙。

source: Yeah! Surely you could’ve scored if you wanted to!
translation: 是啊！只要你想，肯定能得手的！

source: W-Well… You guys know I have a lot of social anxiety… And I like to have my fantasies in my games and novels…
translation: 嗯、嗯……你们知道我有很严重的社交焦虑……而我喜欢在游戏和小说里拥有自己的幻想……

source: It’s not that I don’t want to, but more of I’m not confident at all…
translation: 不是我不想，而是我完全没有自信……

source: Aww, Jin! It’s alright, I’m sure you’ll find someone!
translation: 啊，Jin！没关系，我相信你会找到某个人！

source: Yeah! You’re already getting more confident just being with us here!
translation: 是啊！你只是在这里和我们待在一起，就已经越来越自信了！

source: I-I guess you guys are right… Maybe there is still hope for me soon.
translation: 我、我想你们说得对……也许我很快仍有希望。

source: {i}After Jin settled down, we got back to game, getting drunker with each round.{/i}
translation: {i}Jin平静下来后，我们回到游戏中，每一轮都醉得更厉害。{/i}

source: Oh, how about rock paper scissors? That’s nice and easy!
translation: 哦，石头剪刀布怎么样？又简单又好玩！

source: Whaaaat?! That’s not spicy at all!
translation: 什么啊啊啊？！那一点也不火辣！

source: For once, I agree with her. It’s a little childish don’t you think?
translation: 难得一次，我同意她。这有点幼稚，你不觉得吗？

source: Aww, come on! It sounds fun!
translation: 啊，拜托！听起来很有趣！

source: It’s alright. The rest of us will play.
translation: 没关系。剩下的人会玩。

source: I’ll totally kick Yoichi’s ass.
translation: 我绝对会狠狠打败Yoichi。

source: Like you could!
translation: 你才做不到！

source: Ugh, fine! You boys have fun then, I’ll go and get some more snacks in the kitchen! Come help me out, Emilia!
translation: 唉，好吧！那你们男孩玩得开心，我去厨房再拿些零食！Emilia，来帮我！

source: Fine, I’d rather do that anyway.
translation: 好吧，反正我更愿意做那个。

source: Alriiight! Now that they’re gone, we can make this way more ‘interesting.’
translation: 好——！既然她们走了，我们可以把这变得更“有意思”。

source: *sigh* I already know where this is going. You’re going to say we could make it into—
translation: *叹气* 我已经知道你要说什么了。你会说我们可以把它变成——

source: A strip show!
translation: 脱衣秀！

source: Whoa! How’d you know, Yoshi?!
translation: 哇！你怎么知道的，Yoshi？！

source: You’re predictable, Aiden.
translation: 你太好猜了，Aiden。

source: What?! Why would I wanna do that? Count me out!
translation: 什么？！我为什么要做那个？别算我！

source: Yeah! Let’s settle this somewhere else!
translation: 是啊！我们去别处一决胜负！

source: Come on, Dynamite! I’ll snap you in half with some arm wrestling!
translation: 来吧，Dynamite！我会用掰手腕把你掰成两半！

source: Bring it on!
translation: 放马过来！

source: Awww, I thought they were both getting into the competitive spirit!
translation: 啊，我还以为他们两个都要投入竞争精神了！
